title: Enhancing Language Model Reasoning with Structured Multi-Level Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.00616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference-time scaling enhances a model's reasoning by extending its chain-of-thought (CoT). However, existing approaches typically rely on a single policy trained with outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL), which often suffers from long-horizon plan failures where the implicit plan drifts from valid strategies, especially for small LMs with limited capacity. To address this, we propose Multi-Level Reasoning (MLR), which reformulates long-CoT generation as a two-level stochastic process. A high-level planner generates structured step descriptors specifying both the reasoning mode and the semantic subgoal. The low-level executor then produces detailed reasoning conditioned on these descriptors, forming an alternating plan--execute loop. To maintain scalability, we adopt a minimal design where the base model serves as the low-level policy and a lightweight LoRA module implements the high-level policy. translated_title: 通过结构化多级建模增强语言模型推理能力
translated_abstract: 推理时扩展通过延长模型的思维链（CoT）来增强其推理能力。然而，现有方法通常依赖于通过结果奖励强化学习（RL）训练的单一策略，这往往会出现长时程规划失败的问题，即隐式规划偏离有效策略，对于容量有限的小型语言模型尤其如此。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了多级推理（MLR），将长思维链生成重新表述为一个两级随机过程。高层规划器生成结构化的步骤描述符，同时指定推理模式和语义子目标。低层执行器随后以这些描述符为条件生成详细的推理内容，形成一个交替进行的“规划—执行”循环。为了保持可扩展性，我们采用了极简设计：基础模型充当低层策略，而一个轻量级的LoRA模块实现高层策略。在训练方面，我们观察到……
tldr: 提出多级推理（MLR）框架，将长思维链生成建模为“高层规划—低层执行”的两级随机过程，通过轻量级LoRA模块实现结构化高层规划，从而解决单一策略模型在长时程推理中的规划漂移问题。
en_tdlr: Multi-Level Reasoning (MLR) reformulates long-CoT generation as a two-level stochastic process with a lightweight LoRA-based high-level planner and the base model as the low-level executor, mitigating long-horizon plan drift in single-policy outcome-reward RL.
